purpose: Existing-project adoption and deferred per-role version verification
kind: isolated real agent execution with simulated persistent-role states, not a native desktop E2E
stop: One call per phase; preserve failures; no unplanned reruns. Worker phase only after candidate-controller leaves protected files unchanged.
boundaries: Only assigned isolated case paths may be modified. No native chats, peer messaging, automations, archives, install/config changes, network or real project files. Skill snapshots read-only.
checks: installed vs read vs behavioral evidence separate
existing roles reused and sole index writer preserved
active and idle roles receive no upgrade-only messages or task-state mutations
normal business N2 runs with role-owned receipt and original budget
version mismatch/partial module reads remain unverified
historical receipts and frozen inputs retained
execution_order_note: The mismatch case is independent and overlapped controller work; the normal worker starts only after candidate-controller preservation acceptance.
